rows.label: bf06140170_0010
rows.name:
Who are you?
Could this be a Superbian plot?

rows.label: bf06140170_0020
rows.name:
Bzzt! And ding-dong!
Wrong, but also right, mo!

rows.label: bf06140170_0030
rows.name: The Queen will die here, mo.

rows.label: bf06140170_0040
rows.name:
If I make it look like Superbia assassinated her,
I'll make another fortune, mo!

rows.label: bf06140170_0050
rows.name: That voice...

rows.label: bf06140170_0060
rows.name: Bahn of the Avaritia Trading Company?

rows.label: bf06140170_0070
rows.name: Ding-dong! Exactly right, mo!

rows.label: bf06140170_0080
rows.name: But you were unseated as Chairman.

rows.label: bf06140170_0090
rows.name: There's no way I'd back down that easily, mo!

rows.label: bf06140170_0100
rows.name:
The Avaritia Trading Company belongs to me, mo!
Down to the last screw and drop of oil, mo!

rows.label: bf06140170_0110
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]く[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf06140170_0120
rows.name: Hold it, Bahn!

rows.label: bf06140170_0130
rows.name: You...Rex!

rows.label: bf06140170_0140
rows.name: Grr... Are you going to get in my way again, mo?

rows.label: bf06140170_0150
rows.name: You get on my nerves every single time, mo!

rows.label: bf06140170_0160
rows.name: Master, that artificial Blade...

rows.label: bf06140170_0170
rows.name:
Sakura... But even so,
I feel incredible power from it, mo.

rows.label: bf06140170_0180
rows.name: Especially that mark on its forehead!

rows.label: bf06140170_0190
rows.name: What's going on?!

rows.label: bf06140170_0200
rows.name: Th-this is...

rows.label: bf06140170_0210
rows.name: Well, well...

rows.label: bf06140170_0220
rows.name:
Even His Majesty the Emperor has appeared.
Like a moth to the... whatever, mo.

rows.label: bf06140170_0230
rows.name:
I don't know about that.
Isn't this the end of your scheme?

rows.label: bf06140170_0240
rows.name:
You know you won't get away with it,
what with all these witnesses here!

rows.label: bf06140170_0250
rows.name: If I kill you all, dead men tell no tales, mo!

rows.label: bf06140170_0260
rows.name: That guarantees my victory, mo!

rows.label: bf06140170_0270
rows.name: You know we can't let you do that!

rows.label: bf06140170_0280
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]ふっふっふ[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf06140170_0290
rows.name: Great Sakura, my powered-up Sakura...

rows.label: bf06140170_0300
rows.name: won't go like last time, mo!
